subject.title: fix(ui): apply Context Profile presets via config.patch to avoid SecretRef rejection

question: After resolving the current merge conflict, should Context Profile presets remain a direct `config.patch` operation that commits three settings independently of other staged form or raw-editor changes?
rationale: The implementation is well-tested, but the choice changes write atomicity, dirty-draft reconciliation, and ownership of curated config values; automation cannot safely establish that permanent contract.

options.title: Approve Direct Patching
options.body: Rebase onto current `main`, retain the narrow patch and reconciliation design, rerun focused proof, and merge after owner review.

options.title: Keep Shared Save Transaction
options.body: Repair the general full-config SecretRef round trip and keep presets within the existing Save or Apply transaction.

options.title: Pause Context Profiles
options.body: Defer preset application until maintainers settle the intended config-write transaction model.

recommendation.title: Approve Direct Patching
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current `main`, retain the narrow patch and reconciliation design, rerun focused proof, and merge after owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the Context Profile/config preset UX and provides the strongest product-history signal for its intended interaction contract.
